_comment: Single-target drag-deceleration scenario for sub-project A. Target starts at 1m range moving at 5 m/s, decelerates under quadratic drag (k=0.5 in metric units, 1/(m·s)). Analytic trajectory over 4s (80 frames @ 20Hz): v(4) = 5/(1+0.5*5*4) ≈ 0.45 m/s, r(4) ≈ 5.80m. Amplitude is intentionally near the CFAR detection threshold so frames where CFAR misses force the tracker to predict from its motion model alone. Under those coast streaks the algorithm difference shows: CV-Kalman (algorithm=kf) overshoots (constant-velocity assumption), drag-EKF (algorithm=ekf) follows the drag curve, IMM (algorithm=imm) should lock onto its drag constituent.
